headline: United States GP: two days to Friday practice, race 25 October at 15:00 local
whyCareReason: Antonelli leads Russell by 102 points heading into COTA. Friday practice is two days away.
teaser: Paddock setup Wednesday in Austin. COTA is 23-25 October. Mercedes lead Ferrari by 134 points.
story: There is no on-track session on Wednesday, 21 October, as teams complete paddock preparation and track walks at Circuit of the Americas. Formula1.com lists the United States Grand Prix for 23-25 October 2026, with practice starting Friday and the race Sunday, 25 October at 15:00 local time. The circuit measures 5.513 km across 56 laps. Kimi Antonelli leads the drivers' championship with 340 points to George Russell's 238, an advantage of 102 points. Mercedes lead Ferrari 578 to 444 in the constructors' standings. No Austin lap time has been recorded.
stakes: The lead is 102 points with Austin, Mexico, Brazil, Las Vegas, Qatar and Abu Dhabi still to run. Nothing in Texas has been timed yet.
rivalryAngle: The championship does not move on Wednesday. The next chance to move it is Friday practice in Austin.
funFacts: Formula1.com timetable: United States GP, 23-25 October 2026, race at 15:00 local on 25 October.
Circuit: 5.513 km, 56 laps, 308.405 km. Turn 1 features a 41-meter elevation climb.
Standings unchanged: Antonelli 340, Russell 238, gap 102. Mercedes 578, Ferrari 444, McLaren 339.
